1.consolidated_definition: Reñir entre dos personas: disputa verbal que mantiene su amistad.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To quarrel between two people: verbal dispute that maintains their friendship.

reference_definitions: Reñir de palabras dos personas. Disgustarse.

2.consolidated_definition: Tocar la guitarra o el cuatro aislando las notas. Puntear.
2.en_consolidated_definition: To play the guitar or cuatro while isolating individual notes. Strumming.
